snippet.title: Voxel Playground - Official Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Voxel Playground, a voxel-based sandbox zombie shooter developed by CyDream. Players will make use of a wide array of weapons and abilities to take out enemy after enemy from lowly zombies to towering enemies across a voxel world. Voxel Playground is coming soon.
